register.labelZh: WRAP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: wrap something up 可以用來描述包裝禮物、包裹和容易打破的物件。；wrap up 和 wrap somebody up 可以用來描述穿上保暖衣物,或用外套和毛氈把某人包好。；談論圍巾、絲帶、毛巾、繩子和手臂時,可以使用 wrap something around somebody orsomething。；wrap up 或 wrap it up 可以用來叫人停止說話,但應小心使用,因為語氣可能顯得不耐煩。
register.summaryEn: Wrap something up helps you describe covering gifts, parcels and objects that can break easily. Wrap up and wrap somebody up help you describe wearing warm clothes or covering someone with a coat or blanket. Wrap something around somebody or something is useful when talking about scarves, ribbons, towels, ropes and arms. Wrap up or wrap it up can tell someone to stop talking, although the expression should be used carefully because it may sound impatient.
